detail: Level-1 (within-person) residual table derived from the Ch.4 alcohol1 fit (epsilon_ij, standardized and normalized residuals); not raw data.
Level-2 (between-person) residual table derived from the Ch.4 alcohol1 fit (zeta_0i, zeta_1i random-effect estimates); not raw data.
Combined level-1 and level-2 residual table derived from the Ch.4 alcohol1 fit (epsilon_ij, zeta_0i, zeta_1i and standardized variants); superset of the two _resid tables, not raw data.
A 38-subject subset of wages_pp (ID LNW EXPER BLACK HGC_9); Ch.5 fits lme(lnw ~ exper + hgc.9 + exper:black, random=~exper|id) to it, but it is a subset of another object of the same source.
Wide person-level form: one row per adolescent, the five occasions as columns TOL11-TOL15 (16 persons). The grouping unit is no column of the table; the long form is tolerance_pp.
Wide person-level form: one row per person (1122), the three waves as columns ALC1-ALC3 and PEER1-PEER3. The grouping unit is no column; the long form is alcohol2_pp.
One row per subject (104) with daily/weekly mood as wide columns (MOOD1-12, WEEKMOOD1-12, AVERMOOD00-12). No repeated grouping column within the table.
Only two columns, AGE and IQ (18 rows): a single growth trajectory with no id/grouping column. Ch.6 uses it to illustrate variable transformations and fits no model.
One row per subject (89): WEEKS, CENSOR. Continuous-time relapse-to-use survival data (Ch.13 Kaplan-Meier). One observation per person, no grouping.
Superseded copy of alcohol_relapse (one row per subject: ID, WEEKS, CENSOR; integer WEEKS). Person-level continuous-time survival, no grouping structure.
One row per subject (104): WEEK, CENSOR, NASAL. Person-level survival summary (the person-period form is cocaine_relapse_pp). No grouping.
Raw person-level form, one row per representative (168): NAME, TIME, CENSOR, DEM. Person-level survival; the person-period form is congress_pp.
One row per subject (1393): ONSET, AGE, CENSOR, FEMALE, sibship covariates. Person-level age-of-onset survival; the person-period form is depression_pp.
One row per physician (812): entry/exit times, CENSOR, parttime, age. Continuous-time survival (Ch.13), one observation per person, no grouping.
One row per youth (1553): TIME, CENSOR, ABUSED, BLACK, ABLACK. Person-level survival; the person-period form is firstarrest_pp.
One row per subject (1658): age at first cocaine use, CENSOR and covariates. Person-level survival, no grouping.
One row per subject (2974): age, censor. Person-level age-of-first-depression survival, no grouping.
One row per adolescent (180): TIME, CENSOR, PT, PAS. Person-level survival; the person-period form is firstsex_pp.
One row per worker (2074): weeks, censor. Continuous-time survival, no grouping.
One row per driver (57): SECONDS to honk, CENSOR. Continuous-time survival (Ch.13), no grouping.
One row per Supreme Court justice (109): tenure, dead, retire, leave, age, year. Person-level survival, no grouping.
One row per patient (174): DAYS, CENSOR, TREAT. Continuous-time length-of-stay survival, no grouping.
One row per student (3790): LASTPD, FEMALE, CENSOR. Person-level survival; the person-period form is mathdropout_pp.
One row per monkey (123): SESSIONS to criterion, ages, CENSOR, bodywt, female. Person-level survival, no grouping.
One row per released inmate (194): months to rearrest, CENSOR, personal/property, centered age. Continuous-time Cox survival (Ch.14), no grouping.
Raw person-level form, one row per subject (391): TIME, CENSOR, AGE. Person-level survival; the person-period form is suicide_pp.
One row per teacher (3941): T (years to turnover), CENSOR. Person-level survival; the person-period form is teachers_pp.
Raw person-level form, one row per academic (260): TIME, CENSOR. Person-level survival; the person-period form is tenure_pp.
